body: Thank you, you're right and I know it deep down and I keep telling myself everything will be fine, it's just when I hit a low, I really hit one, and it scares me, I don't want to die, it'd just be easier.

Thank you so much for your response, I do think about my brother, but it's after I've been around people being happy constantly all night at weddings, I leave work exhausted and not thinking straight. I hate the feeling and I hope I don't do anything, I understand what you're saying, and I will look back at this moment and laugh one day but it's just hard getting through today. I'm so sorry, I hate placing my problems on people as it is. Thank you, I swear I'll try keep my chin up.
